units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:1">Ḥull. I, 1</cite>, a. fr. <he>חרש ש׳ וקטן</he> a deaf and dumb person, an insane person, and a minor.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:1:11">Y. Ter. I, 40ᵇ</cite> <he>סימני ש׳ וכ׳</he> the symptoms of insanity.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:3">Tosef. Ter. I, 3</cite> <he>פעמים ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H01081"><he>חָלַם</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 8:6">Yoma VIII, 6</cite> <he>כלב ש׳</he> a mad dog.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:7">Ab. IV, 7</cite> <he>ש׳ רשע וכ׳</he> is a fool, a wicked man &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Sot. III, 4</cite> <he>חסיד ש׳</he> a foolish saint; <cite ref="Sotah 21b:5">ib. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>היכי דמי חסיד ש׳ וכ׳</he> what is meant by a foolish saint? When, for instance, a woman is drowning in the river, and he says, it is not becoming to look at her and save her.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 7:1">Shebi. VII, 1</cite>, sq., v. <cite ref="L00302"><he>לוֹף</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—<he>בכור ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00249"><he>בּוּכְרָא</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="U00385"><he>שׁוֹטִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00385"><he>שׁוֹטִין</he></cite>. Y. Ter. l. c. <he>אפי׳ שוטה בש׳ וכ׳</he> not even the most insane person will do that.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:7">Ab. Zar. IV, 7</cite> <he>יאבד עולמו מפני הש׳</he> shall God destroy his world on account of the fools (who worship natural objects)? <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 54b:22">Ib. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>וש׳ שקלקלו וכ׳</he> and the fools that do mischief must pay the penalty.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 12b:3">B. Bath. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>מיום שחרב … ונתנה לש׳ וכ׳</he> since the destruction of the Temple, prophecy has been taken away from the prophets and given to madmen and children; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 9:1">Shebi. IX, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 39b">Succ. 39ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="J00594"><he>יַרְבּוּז</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="U00385"><he>שׁוֹטִים</he></cite>.—Fem. <cite ref="U00381"><he>שׁוֹטָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Nedarim 35b:6">Ned. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>בין פיקחת בין ש׳</he> whether sane or insane.
